title: Honeypot I put together
description: TheLeaf Threat Observatory operates honeypot sensors that mimic common internet services such as WordPress, Tomcat, phpMyAdmin, SMTP, Telnet, and RDP to capture unsolicited traffic and automated probing attempts. These sensors collect data on login attempts, credential guessing, and exploitation probes, publishing categorized observations with a delay. The project aims to provide real-world insight into automated scanning and attack techniques without enabling actual exploitation or access. It serves as an educational and research tool rather than a direct threat or vulnerability.
